description: The offer for an After Hours AI phone receptionist on the owner's own business line, prepaid and billed per ANSWERED call: calls10: 10 calls for $15; calls50: 50 calls for $75 ($1.50 a call). A call is charged only when your line answers a real phone call and it lasts 20 seconds or more. Not charged: calls under that, robocalls the line recognises, calls from your own numbers or from ours, website and widget chats, text messages, and any call whose transcript cannot be read. At zero the line keeps answering. Up to 10 calls past zero are carried over and taken from your next pack. You are emailed at 3 calls left, at zero, and at 10 calls past zero. The line is never switched off automatically; past that, Odile Labs may pause it by hand after emailing you. Offered in: US. Use it before set_up_answering_line, to tell the owner exactly what they would buy. Needs no sign-in, reads no account and changes nothing. Returns { product, packs[{id, calls, cents}], per_call_cents, min_billable_seconds, answered_call_rule, at_zero, countries[], owner_must[], terms_url, set_up_with, top_up_with }.
